summary: The OccHealthInfluenzaEditAll is a web user control designed for managing occupational health influenza immunization data. The control allows for the display and management of influenza immunization records in a grid format and handles data binding, sorting, and user interactions such as saving or canceling changes.
purpose: The purpose of the OccHealthInfluenzaEditAll control is to facilitate the editing and management of influenza immunization records for students in a web-based environment, supporting functionalities like filtering, sorting, and saving data.

workflows.name: Grid Data Edit
steps: Initialize JavaScript variables to track dirty fields.
Iterate over GridView rows to attach change functions and gather field IDs.
Register startup script with field IDs for client-side tracking.
Apply sorting and filtering based on user session and input parameters.
Handle row commands to invoke update functions based on user input.

validations: ValidationSummary1 control is used for aggregating form validations.
conditions: Show save/cancel buttons conditionally based on row count or enrollment ID.
Toggle visibility of elements based on read-only status or H1N1 flag.
system_behavior: GridView utilizes server-side binding and rendering.
JavaScript functions dynamically generated based on grid data.
User session is checked before data operations to ensure session validity.
dependencies: HSPnet.Framework for session and data handling.
User control interacts with HSPnet application framework.
exceptions: Cancel data operation if user session is null.
Hide save/cancel controls when conditions dictate to prevent improper data operations.
